name: Aryan Kapoor
bio:
Aryan's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. This early exposure fueled his desire to combine his marketing acumen with his love for racing. After graduating with a degree in Marketing and Communications, Aryan landed an internship at a local karting track, where he honed his skills in social media management and event promotion.

Aryan believes that motorsport marketing is all about storytelling and creating a strong brand identity. He's adept at crafting engaging content that resonates with fans and sponsors alike. His innovative ideas and data-driven approach make him a valuable asset to any team. At Anderson Racing, he is working hard to build a loyal fanbase.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Aryan is of average height with a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a notebook filled with marketing ideas.
Prefers communicating through short, punchy memos.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
